messages:
PagerDuty: :rotating_light: INC0012345 - serving-runtime: high-rate NCCL hangs reported from 'dedicated-gpu-pool-3' - auto-escalation to infra on-call

InfraBot: auto-attach: logs collected to s3://redwood-incidents/2123456789/ - suspect multi-GPU collective timeouts; sample: 
```
[2026-03-15T20:01:02Z] ERROR nccl: comm_rank=2 nccl: unhandled comm error: timeout expired
[2026-03-15T20:01:02Z] ERROR cuda: gpu0: CUDA out of memory while allocating 1.2G
```

Alice W: I'm on it. Paging @Dave SRE (oncall). Is this affecting production customer jobs or internal tests?

Benji: Seeing high 95th latency on batch-generation and multiple pods in CrashLoopBackOff. Node logs show repeated `ncclCommInitRank` retries. Possibly a node-level NVLink flake + kernel driver requeues.

Carla M: quick checks: `kubectl get pods -n redwood-serving -o wide | grep dedicated-gpu-pool-3` shows 4/12 pods failing. Running `kubectl describe pod <pod>` shows OOMs for shard processes.

Dave SRE: Acknowledged. Triage plan: 1) Quarantine affected node(s) 2) Force-failover of active collective jobs to 1-gpu fallback 3) Roll restart of dedicated-gpu-pool-3 kernel driver + controller 4) Keep traffic routing to other pools. Doing step 1 now: cordon + drain with `--ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data`

Benji: Adding: set env NCCL_DEBUG=INFO and NCCL_ASYNC_ERROR_HANDLING=1 on new pods to avoid hard hangs while we root-cause. Also reduce batch size for warmup jobs to avoid OOM during failover.

InfraBot: cordon/evict commands executed for node gpu-12-eu-west; evicting 8 pods. Observed one pod restart where `nvidia-smi` shows GPU3 memory pinned at 98%.

Alice W: Sophie, can you surface customer impact? Any premium jobs failing?

Sophie CS: Confirmed 3 premium customers report degraded inference. Customer A (real-time embeddings) latency spike ~2.5x; Customer B had 12 batch jobs fail; Customer C saw 5% error rate on generation endpoints. Notifying CS leads.

Carla M: Paste of the most relevant log snippet: 
```
[20:00:59] warn nccl : op=allreduce rank=1 failed status=UNRECOVERABLE errno=116 timeout
[20:01:00] error backend: gpu0 cudaMalloc failed: out of memory (namespace=kv_cache)
```

Dave SRE: Immediate mitigations applied: - isolated gpu-12-eu-west - routed traffic away from dedicated-gpu-pool-3 to dedicated-gpu-pool-1/2 - scaled up single-gpu replicas by 30% for critical routes. Early indicators: error rate down from 18% -> 6% in 7 minutes.

Benji: Also pushed a temporary canary config to increase NCCL timeout env NCCL_LL_THRESHOLD_MS from 1000 -> 4000 for lower-retry pressure during repro window.

Alice W: Good. Next: collect full /var/log/nvidia and dmesg from gpu-12-eu-west before we repro boot. Need to preserve driver logs for ENG-ML.

InfraBot: Logs archived at s3://redwood-incidents/2123456789/nvidia-dmesg-gpu-12-eu-west.log.gz

Dave SRE: Planning restart of the ML runtime container on remaining healthy nodes to evict stale NCCL state. Will do rolling restart with 30s grace and backoff.

Sophie CS: I've opened CS ticket CS-9876 and emailed impacted customers with status+mitigations. They requested ETA for full restore; pls ping when stable.

Carla M: Quick reproduction steps (DEV only): `export NCCL_DEBUG=INFO; python -m torch.distributed.launch --nproc_per_node=4 script.py` after forcing a synthetic nvlink error shows hang at `ncclGroupEnd()` — confirms collective-level hang.

Benji: Theory: combined GPU memory pressure + intermittent NVLink link flaps cause NCCL communicator to enter unrecoverable state; communicator stays hung because some ranks crash and others block waiting for collectives. Root cause may be a kernel driver bug on the affected node.

Dave SRE: Handoff plan: I'll stay for 30m to verify stable metrics, then hand off to night on-call @Benji for follow-up and driver team sync in the morning. Action items: create INC ticket, attach logs, schedule postmortem with ENG-ML and drivers.

Alice W: Marking severity P1 -> downgraded to P2 after mitigations and customer impact reduced. Still required: postmortem, driver team engagement, and a fix to our eviction logic to avoid partial-rank kills during collectives.

Sophie CS: Customers notified of degraded -> recovering; we'll follow up with timeline after postmortem.

InfraBot: Incident note appended: `mitigations: node cordoned, traffic rerouted, scale up single-gpu replicas, kernel logs collected`

Dave SRE: Handoff complete to Benji at 2123456845. Leaving follow-ups: ENG-ML to triage reproducible repro, Drivers team to validate kernel/firmware on gpu-12-eu-west, Infra to tighten automated detection for partial-rank crashes.

Benji: Acknowledged. I'll pick this up and open follow-up tickets: INF-5234 (eviction logic), ML-4532 (collective test harness), DRV-2112 (driver regression).

Alice W: Thanks team. Postmortem owners: Benji (lead), Carla (logs), Dave (infra timeline), Sophie (customer comms). Please add notes to the incident doc and set severity in the incident tracker. :white_check_mark:
